title: Split Array With Equal Sum
description: Determine if an array can be split into four parts with equal sum by removing three elements.
pseudocode:
1. pre = prefixSum(nums)
2. for j from 3 to n-3:
3.   set = {}
4.   for i from 1 to j-2:
5.     if pre[i-1] == pre[j-1] - pre[i]: set.add(pre[i-1])
6.   for k from j+2 to n-2:
6.     if pre[k-1] - pre[j] == pre[n-1] - pre[k] and set.has(pre[k-1] - pre[j]): return true

steps.note: Precompute prefix sums for the array [1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1]
Outer loop j marks the second split point at index 3
Inner loop i checks possible first split points before j
Found equal sums for parts, adding to hash set
Inner loop k checks possible third split points after j
Verify if sums match and exist in set, returning true
